question: Do ES and RTY moves and NQ's move relative to ES add directional information beyond NQ's own recent prices, at NQ 5 and 15 minutes?
machinery: forecaster/fan_cond_ema.py as defined by fan_cond_ema_v1 (3ec8838a731fb229): the shared fan, model family, tuning budget, selection on validation CRPS with zero as an option, activation at 99.58% (95 % Bonferroni over the 12 options), evaluation blocks, decision rule at 97.5%

arms.B: own: NQ ret1/ret5/ret15, vwap_dist, rv15, rv60, vol60, phase
arms.C: intermarket: B plus the intermarket set

features.grid: the target's 1440 one-minute slots from 18:00 ET, sessions end to end; each market's last close known at the end of the minute (the panel), carried, never filled backwards
features.sd60: per market, the RMS of its last 60 one-minute log returns on the grid
features.peer_ret_w: ES and RTY log return over the last w minutes over its own sd60 x sqrt(w), w = [1, 5, 15]
features.beta: per session, the OLS slope of NQ's on ES's 1-minute log returns over the 20 sessions before (minutes where both closed a bar); missing with fewer than 10
features.rel_es_w: (NQ's w-minute return - beta x ES's) over NQ's sd60 x sqrt(w), w = [5, 15]
features.comove15: the sign of NQ's 15-minute return where it equals ES's sign, else 0 (diverging)
features.corr_es60: the correlation of NQ's and ES's 1-minute returns over the last 60 minutes
features.peer_base: ES and RTY ['vol60', 'rv15']: relative volume and volatility over usual
features.missing: RTY before its first complete session (2025-09-18) and every warm-up is missing, read as missing

decision.pass: at a horizon, C - A and C - B both have their 97.5 % interval wholly below zero; either horizon
decision.fail: at both horizons C's mean CRPS is not below both A's and B's: no incremental intermarket benefit
decision.after_pass: freeze, then fresh timely forward data on synchronised feeds before any overlay

diagnostics.comove15: together up / together down / diverging / missing
diagnostics.divergence: terciles of |rel_es15| with boundaries from the block's training rows
diagnostics.use: explanation only - never a deployment rule
